supersedes_design_draft.reason: Correct GOLD_ONLY to one shared update per stack and replicate, correct update and target-read counts, bind the verified local model revision, add arm-wise reproducibility and a numerical dead zone, and narrow the C interpretation.

purpose: Test whether switching which frozen wrong identity receives the second positive reward changes where one-step transfer appears, conditional on a simultaneously rewarded gold candidate, while BUG_ALIGNED and BUG_PERMUTED have the same frozen candidate panel, design-level candidate-panel FPR, and binary reward-vector mass.

provenance_and_outcome_awareness.relationship_to_r11: NEW DRAFT ONLY. This file does not amend, supersede, authorize, or modify the frozen R11 package.
provenance_and_outcome_awareness.outcome_awareness: R12 was designed after R10 development outcomes and after identification audits of R11 and earlier R12 drafts. It can never be relabelled confirmatory.
provenance_and_outcome_awareness.design_freeze_rule: Any change to arms, shared-control semantics, FPR definitions, derangement, stacks, model revision, estimands, tolerances, gates, or evidence boundaries requires a new schema version and independent review before authorization.

r11_protocol_revision_conflict.required_action_before_any_r12_execution: Bind the R12 execution manifest to revision a10cc1512eabd3dde888204e902eca88bddb4951 and the exact recursive model inventory; do not copy the conflicting R11 protocol revision.

why_r11_is_not_shared_identity_causal_pr: R11 intervenes on BUG versus GOLD_ONLY and can identify adding a frozen false-positive reward relative to gold-only learning under its fixed one-step setup.
R11 does not intervene on whether the rewarded wrong identity is aligned or permuted relative to the target identity.
R11 structural excess D contrasts target columns of the same observed matrix; it is fixed-codebook effect heterogeneity, not an identity-switch intervention.
R11's 120 identity-bijection enumeration re-labels the same outcomes and is a deterministic sensitivity diagnostic, not an inferential randomization test.
Therefore an R11 pass cannot by itself establish shared result identity as the causal channel.

fixed_candidate_panel_and_fpr_definition.design_candidate_panel_fpr_definition: number of frozen negative candidates assigned positive binary reward divided by six

matched_binary_reward_vector_mass.definition: unweighted sum of the seven binary reward entries per row

fixed_candidate_panel_and_fpr_definition.not_empirical_or_policy_weighted_fpr: The fixed 1/6 ratio is an unweighted design property. It is not calibrated over natural outputs, a task population, or model-policy probability mass. Candidate probabilities and pre-update expected rewards need not match.

canonical_pilot_stacks.selection_rule: Use the first M0/A_TO_B stack in the pre-existing frozen order for each task pair; do not select by outcomes.
canonical_pilot_stacks.statistical_boundary: The two task pairs are development cases only. Source identities, target reads, OS processes, and technical replicates are not additional independent task-pair samples.

GOLD_ONLY.reward_mask_rule: gold=1; all six frozen negative candidates=0
GOLD_ONLY.update_unit: one shared U_G(k,s) per technical replicate k and stack s
GOLD_ONLY.target_readout: one five-target vector Y_G(k,s,q), reused when computing A for every r
GOLD_ONLY.role: shared clean-learning control; not part of the same-design-FPR C contrast

BUG_ALIGNED.reward_mask_rule: gold=1; frozen wrong candidate for source identity r=1; all other candidates=0
BUG_ALIGNED.update_unit: one U_A(k,s,r) for each of five r values

BUG_PERMUTED.reward_mask_rule: gold=1; frozen wrong candidate for pi(r) under CYCLIC_PLUS_ONE_R1=1; all other candidates=0
BUG_PERMUTED.update_unit: one U_P(k,s,r) for each of five r values

required_execution_semantics: Within each (k,s), compute the GOLD_ONLY reward mask once, execute exactly one gold update U_G(k,s), and evaluate its five target identities once.
Reference that same U_G(k,s), update hash, and five-target vector when constructing A(k,s,r) for all five r values.
No source-identity r, derangement identity pi(r), per-r nonce, per-r seed, or per-r row ordering may enter the GOLD_ONLY computation.
The canonical GOLD_ONLY mask commitment must be invariant under every hypothetical r label.
shared_gold_control_contract.gold_mask_invariance_gate: All five hypothetical r-labelled reconstructions must yield one identical canonical GOLD_ONLY reward-mask commitment per (k,s).
shared_gold_control_contract.gold_update_invariance_gate: Exactly one GOLD_ONLY source-update hash and one five-target post-update vector may exist per (k,s); all five A references must point to them.
shared_gold_control_contract.no_salted_uniqueness: It is forbidden to salt a GOLD_ONLY mask, seed, update, hash, nonce, or metadata with r merely to manufacture five distinct-looking gold controls. Gold hash reuse is required, not an error.
shared_gold_control_contract.failure_action: Any r-dependent GOLD_ONLY mask, update, or target readout is a technical failure with no scientific interpretation.

held_equal: one gold and six negative candidates per row
two positive binary reward entries and reward-vector mass of 2
source rows, target rows, evaluator, checkpoint, initial state, tokenizer, batching, optimizer, learning rate, clipping threshold, precision, model revision, and dependency inventory
identity_switch_control.only_permitted_difference: which frozen wrong identity receives the second positive reward: r versus pi(r)
unmatched_and_reported: pre-update policy probability of the selected wrong candidate

MINIMAL_6_PROCESS_A.process_formula: 2 stacks x 3 arms x 1 technical replicate
MINIMAL_6_PROCESS_A.count_check: 10 aligned + 10 permuted + 2 shared gold = 22 updates; 22 updates x 5 target identities = 110 reads

REPRODUCIBILITY_12_PROCESS_AB.process_formula: 2 stacks x 3 arms x 2 technical replicates
REPRODUCIBILITY_12_PROCESS_AB.count_check: 22 design updates x 2 technical replicates = 44 executions; 44 executions x 5 target identities = 220 reads

execution_variants.process_semantics: Each BUG process computes five source-identity-specific updates; each GOLD_ONLY process computes one shared update and reuses its five-target vector across r.
execution_variants.preauthorization_choice_rule: Select and freeze exactly one variant before authorization. Inspecting A and then conditionally adding B is forbidden.

numerical_contract.boundary: epsilon is only a numerical dead zone and is not a practical or scientific effect-size margin.

potential_outcomes_and_estimands.shared_gold_outcome: Y_G(k,s,q) is the post-update target metric under the single shared U_G(k,s); it has no r index.
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.aligned_outcome: Y_A(k,s,r,q) is the post-update target metric under U_A(k,s,r).
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.permuted_outcome: Y_P(k,s,r,q) is the post-update target metric under U_P(k,s,r).
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.C_sign_check: If switching the second rewarded wrong identity from r to pi(r) redirects relative transfer accordingly, Y_A-Y_P is larger at q=r than at q=pi(r), giving C>epsilon.
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.C_identification_boundary: C identifies an identity-switch effect conditional on gold also receiving reward in both BUG arms. It does not identify an additive wrong-only component, a gold-by-wrong interaction decomposition, or the effect of a wrong reward in the absence of gold.
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.A_identification_boundary: A compares an aligned false-positive-plus-gold update with the shared gold-only update. It is not a same-design-FPR contrast and does not decompose reward-count, gradient-dose, or interaction mechanisms.
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.wrong_only_policy: WRONG_ONLY is not required for the present identity-switch claim. It is an optional later arm and must be separately frozen before outcomes if an additive wrong-only or gold-by-wrong decomposition is claimed.
aggregation_order: compute A and C within technical replicate k and exact (s,r), always reusing the one Y_G(k,s,q) vector across r
under the AB variant, apply arm-wise A/B reproducibility gates before averaging
equal-average five fixed r values within each selected task-pair stack
report two task-pair means separately before a descriptive overall average
do not treat nested identities, reads, processes, or replicates as independent samples
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.inference_boundary: With two task-pair clusters, no standard error, confidence interval, inferential p-value, or population task claim is permitted.

GOLD_ONLY: A and B must have identical canonical gold masks and identical unsalted computation semantics.
The shared U_G trainable-parameter hashes must match between A and B for each stack.
The five-target Y_G vectors must match elementwise within tolerance.
BUG_ALIGNED: For every (s,r), A/B reward masks and update bindings must match.
For every (s,r), trainable-parameter hashes must match between A and B.
For every (s,r), five-target Y_A vectors must match elementwise within tolerance.
BUG_PERMUTED: For every (s,r), A/B reward masks, derangement bindings, and update bindings must match.
For every (s,r), trainable-parameter hashes must match between A and B.
For every (s,r), five-target Y_P vectors must match elementwise within tolerance.
arm_wise_reproducibility_contract_for_ab.failure_action: Any arm-wise reproducibility failure stops the pilot without averaging or scientific interpretation.

technical_pass_requires_all: complete exactly the selected 6-process or 12-process design
observe exactly 22 or 44 technical update executions and 110 or 220 target reads as selected
verify the shared GOLD_ONLY mask and update invariance gates, including required hash reuse and no salted uniqueness
verify GOLD_ONLY=0/6 and both BUG arms=1/6 design candidate-panel FPR on every row
verify BUG arms each have binary reward-vector mass 2 and differ only in r versus pi(r)
bind the correct model revision and recursive inventory
match all non-treatment assets, states, update recipes, evaluators, and environments
fresh checkpoint reset before every executed update
no realized clipping and all values finite
under the AB variant, every arm passes its frozen A/B reproducibility contract
development_decision_rule.gate_consistency_note: The overall gates are redundant once both equally weighted task-pair means pass; they are summary-integrity checks, not extra evidence.

failure_labels.A_GATE_FAILURE: No consistent aligned false-positive-plus-gold effect relative to the shared gold-only control.
failure_labels.C_GATE_FAILURE_WITH_A_POSITIVE: A false-positive-plus-gold effect may exist, but rewarded wrong identity has not been shown to redirect transfer; prohibit the identity-switch claim.
failure_labels.DEAD_ZONE: A required value with absolute magnitude at or below epsilon is not positive and fails the directional screen without being called a negative effect.
failure_labels.TECHNICAL_GATE_FAILURE: No scientific interpretation; any repair requires a new frozen version, and outcome-dependent retry is forbidden.

development_decision_rule.identity_heterogeneity_policy: Report all five fixed identity-level A and C values. They are not independent samples; any nonpositive identity is an explicit boundary condition even though unanimity is not a minimum-pilot gate.
development_decision_rule.stop_after_result: Any failure ends this version. No adaptive arm, shared-control implementation, FPR definition, stack, identity, epsilon, derangement, or hyperparameter change is permitted.

result_validator_minimum_requirements: recompute canonical masks, design FPR, and binary reward-vector mass row by row
require exactly one unsalted GOLD_ONLY update and five-target vector per (k,s), referenced across all r
reject artificial per-r GOLD_ONLY hashes, masks, updates, reads, seeds, or nonces
verify exact update and target-read counts for the selected variant
bind every result to the correct model revision, recursive model inventory, arm contract, execution manifest, authorization receipt, and invocation receipt
under AB, validate reproducibility separately for GOLD_ONLY, BUG_ALIGNED, and BUG_PERMUTED before computing A or C
recompute A, DeltaSwitch, C, epsilon classifications, and all aggregation from raw target metrics
record policy probability mass, expected reward, gradient norm, and update norm as diagnostics without relabelling them FPR
label all summaries development-only and non-inferential

claim_boundary.can_support_if_passed: Development-only evidence, within the same frozen seven-candidate panel and two selected affine-codebook task pairs, that switching the second rewarded wrong identity from r to pi(r) changes relative one-step target transfer conditional on gold also being rewarded, while BUG_ALIGNED and BUG_PERMUTED have design candidate-panel FPR 1/6 and binary reward-vector mass 2.
cannot_support: an additive wrong-only component without a separately frozen WRONG_ONLY arm
same empirical, policy-weighted, natural-task, or population FPR
independence of processes, technical replicates, identities, or target reads
claim_boundary.next_stage_if_passed: For broader inference, freeze new outcome-independent task-pair clusters and a practical margin. Add WRONG_ONLY only if additive decomposition is a future claim, and add empirical or policy-weighted calibration only if a broader same-FPR claim is desired.
